name: Pure Marriage ~Akai Ito Monogatari - Harem Hen~
original_name: Pure Marriage  ～赤い糸物語 ハーレム編～
source:
The childhood friend who always lived next door, Madoka.
The princess he always adored, Celica.
The younger sister he cherished, Sakura.

"I want to marry all 3 of them!"
